text:
aj: Heads up CI canary image push failing on registry with 401 after my Dockerfile tweak.
ci-bot: pipeline/canary-image #742 failed — push to registry.redwood-inference.com returned 401 Unauthorized
aj: Full log snippet:
```
ERR: PUT /v2/redwood/canary/blobs/uploads/... 401 {"errors":[{"code":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"authentication required"}]}
```
aj: I rolled back my local change and could push, so looks related to new `COPY --chown` layer ordering
maria: did we rotate service account keys in the last 24h? maybe token scope changed
devops-bot: service-account/key-rotations: rediscovered 3 keys rotated by ops at 1769991200
sophie: can you rerun pipeline with `--no-cache` and `CI_REGISTRY_SKIP_CACHE=true`? cache corruption sometimes causes auth header to get dropped in kaniko
aj: starting a manual rerun without cache now
aj: rerun failed again, same 401
aj: bisected to commit 7b4a2e3 — the Dockerfile reorder that introduced an extra layer with registry credentials written in build args
maria: can you paste the Dockerfile snippet? we shouldn't be writing creds into layers
aj: snippet:
```
ARG BUILD_SECRET
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=ssh ssh-agent && echo $BUILD_SECRET > /tmp/secret && cp /tmp/secret /app/.buildtoken
```
maria: yeah that would bake something in if mount not used properly
devops-bot: checking registry audit: several short-lived 401 spikes at 1769998500-1769998600 from CI runners
sophie: if we can't fix quickly, workaround: push to staging-registry (internal) then mirror, or set `kaniko --single-snapshot`
maria: aj — could you try adding `--cleanup=true` and `--cache-repo=""` to kaniko run and rerun? I'll trigger a job now
ci-bot: manual job #742.rerun started by maria
maria: job succeeded — push completed to registry.redwood-inference.com
aj: confirmed, registry now accepted the image. Noted `--cache-repo` appears to be culprit
aj: i'll open a PR to remove build arg copy and fix secret usage, and add CI step to run `kaniko --cleanup=true` for canary builds
sophie: thanks, please include bisect notes in the PR description
aj: will do. closing this thread. :thumbsup:
